question: In the fluidized-bed co-incineration of sewage sludge, by what factor does the Fe content (wt %) of the agglomerate neck exceed that of the silica sand?
rendered: The Fe content in the agglomerate neck structures is 0.25 wt % while in the silica sand it is 0.50 wt %. The Fe content in the agglomerate neck structures is 0.25/0.50 = 0.5 times that of the silica sand.
